| `delegateAgenticWork` | ANY Anakin capability (search/scrape/crawl/map/research/wire/browser + schedule) | durable → Inngest `thread/run`; returns run_id |
| `generateImage` / `transcribeAudio` | media generation requests | live when `IMAGE_MODEL`/`TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL` set per workspace/env |

- `askQuestion` → `AskUserQuestion` schema (packages/ui
  `ask-user-questions.tsx:37`) — single zod schema shared server+client.
- Auto-approve switch: toolApproval config + `approval_requests` row status
  auto-"approved" when workflow.auto_approve; system message emitted
  "auto-approved via settings".
- **NO auto-plan/wiring**: LLM answers plain text, never auto-creates a plan or
  binds a workflow on its own. `showPlan` only fires after user explicitly asks
  ("create a workflow / plan this"). A 2nd user message is NOT a plan trigger.
- **Attachments → LLM-readable**: image/pdf/video dropped into ChatComposer get
  converted to LLM input parts (image → data URL / base64 image part; pdf →
  extracted text part) before the call; media tools return real content.

## E. Durable execution (Inngest): `thread/run`

- ONE event: `thread/run` (down from pile). `thread-runner` function:
  1. fetch everything from DB (thread, plan, memory summaries, previous runs).
  2. `generateText`/`ToolLoopAgent` with the SAME tool set minus the durable
     re-delegation (no recursion);
  3. persist each step/tool into `runs` + `run_activities` + broadcast.
  4. sleep/resume via `runs.status=sleeping` + `schedule-tick` (real Inngest
     cron trigger; fires due `schedules` + wakes sleeping runs; sees `webhook_hooks`
     fired → `trigger=resume`) — and register ALL functions
     in `apps/web/src/app/api/inngest/route.ts` serve list.
  5. notify on completion/failure → `notifications`.
- Idempotency: `runs.status` gate `pending→running` with `select … for update`
  in Postgres; retries honor existing activity instead of re-running.
- Cost caps: check BEFORE each step (realtime), not after the run (fix the
  old post-hoc bug).
- Bounded recovery: attempt count tracked in `run_activities`
  (`type=system`, `step_label="recovery"`, detail) against
  `EXECUTION_MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS` — no separate table.

## F. Frontend state (zustand)

- Zustand stores (each `[thread]`, `[sidebar]`, `[chatComposer]`, `[ui/theme]`,
  `[auth]`) — keeps server components pure; zustand used max; no useState sprawl.
- `threadId` navigation: `router.push('/workspace/'+workspaceId+'/'+id, { scroll:false })` — both segments carried; a thread is always viewed from the context workspace (own PERSONAL or a joined workspace).
  updating only param; page reads `params.threadId` once → store. ChatComposer
  layout: centered when no messages → bottom once first message exists.
- ChatComposer: queue (ordered, editable, removable, durable-backend),
  token-quality slider formula: `maxTokens per CHAT request` (this is what the
  slider means; maps to `streamText.maxOutputTokens`, not a run budget),
  file/image/pdf attach → compress (canvas, WebP, quality 0.8, max 2000px) →
  Supabase Storage → `files` row + `UIMessage` attachments.
- Queue `chat_messages.status=queued`: on run finish, drain SEQUENTIALLY —
  deliver message, wait for that response to finish, then next (no parallel
  queue burst). Edited/reordered queue → DB rows updated in place, order kept.

## G. Memory (mem0, ONE place per user, thread-scoped)

- ONE mem0 store per app user (as chosen): every thread's memories live there,
  scoped by `metadata.threadId`. `storeMemory`/`searchMemory` tools:
  - thread scope: `{scope:"thread", threadId}` — memories only reprompted for
    that thread.
  - global scope: `{scope:"global"}` — **program-given memory injected
    beforehand**, works across ALL workspaces/threads/apps for that user (not
    per-workspace). E.g. capability schemas, user prefs, standing instructions.
- `packages/agent/src/adapters/README.md:1` resolution: adapter schemas exposed
  to LLM via GLOBAL memory (per decision) — one tool `listCapabilities` returns
  schemas; keeps them OO-reflectable.

## I. Permission model — SINGLE-USER (no invites, roles, or sharing)

- Each `auth.users` row owns exactly ONE workspace (`workspaces.created_by`),
  created at signup as "Personal" (is_default). Owner = the only user.
- All RLS is owner-only (`user_id`/`created_by` = `auth.uid()`); child tables
  (runs, run_activities, chat_messages, plans, approval_requests, schedules)
  chain through their thread/workflow to the owner. No membership reads.
- Tables `workspace_members`, `invites`, `thread_shares` and enums `role`,
  `thread_role`, `invite_kind`, `invite_status` are DROPPED (migration 0004 +
  raw supabase cleanup, applied to prod).

### Keys resolution order (chat / run)
```
1. workspace keys (the workspace the thread belongs to)
2. env defaults (ANAKIN_API_KEY / GROQ_API_KEY / MEM0_API_KEY / models)
```
(No member-override step; no `prefer_own_keys_in_shared` toggle.)

## J. Packages map (rewrite targets)

| Package | Old | New |
|---|---|---|
| `@aevryn/auth` | better-auth | Supabase client + SSR + google + onboarding trigger |
| `@aevryn/api` | tRPC router | dropped for chat (chat = `POST /api/chat`); keep minimal health/metadata route if needed |
| `@aevryn/agent` | runtime + registry + regex | `runAgent` live (streamText), durable `thread-runner`, tools from schema library |
| `@aevryn/workflow` | god service 66 methods | split: thread-service, plan-service, run-service, activity-service, notification-service, key-service, queue-service, schedule-service, webhook-hook-service (NO member-service — removed) |
| `@aevryn/inngest` | 3 functions, 1 served | serve ALL fns; `thread-runner` + `schedule-tick` (Inngest cron) + notify |
| `@aevryn/db` | 16 tables legacy | new SCHEMA.md (14 tables) + `schedules`/`webhook_hooks` + Supabase migration |
| `@aevryn/env` | server only | server + web split, USER keys via DB Vault (see ENV.md) |
| `@aevryn/ui` | components (keep) | real-data wiring (dropdown, nav, dialogs), ChatMessage attachments, ProfileDialog, Toaster mount |

## K. Flow verification scenarios (must "just work")

1. **"Hi"** → user text only, LLM plain text, NO tool call, NO new workflow.
2. **"plan me a laptop comparison"** → LLM askQuestion (MCQ) → user answers →
   showPlan accordion → workflowApproval (approve/decline/bind/run) → bind →
   `thread/run` → ThinkingSteps stream research/scrape sub-tasks into the SAME
   assistant message → final answer text appended.
3. **"scrape X.com profile" (no plan)** → delegateAgenticWork → durable run →
   run_activities stream → final text in same message.
4. **user closes tab mid-run** → run continues in Inngest; reopening
   workspace reloads `chat_messages` + `run_activities` → renders state.
5. **queued "delete workflow" while run active** → message queued durable;
   once run completes → queued delivered SEQUENTIALLY (wait each).
6. **auto-approve ON** → approval resolves instantly + system message.
9. **deleted thread** → soft-archive 30 days (trash), recover → live;
   after 30 days hard-delete (incl. runs/activities/files).
10. **"re-run last run"** → play a rerun (trigger=rerun) with same plan, no
    new chat; hits new `runs` row, streams activities again.
11. **first message** → auto-titles thread; title editable after.

## L. Non-goals / pinned decisions
- Markdown rendering: FUTURE (write API to be parser-friendly — parts, no
  prose-heavy gating). Output contract ready for it.
- Media generation: IMAGE + TRANSCRIPTION SHIPPED in MVP (lazy-load provider
  when `IMAGE_MODEL`/`TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL` configured); SPEECH/VIDEO stay schemas
  only until models exist. Attachments always converted to LLM-readable parts.
- Sub-agents in parallel: FUTURE phase (see FEATURES.md); design tool outputs as
  containers so sub-agent results merge into `run_activities`.
- Creating multiple owned workspaces: FUTURE (pro tier). MVP = 1 owned
  Personal workspace. No joined/invited workspaces.
- Single-user only: no members, no thread sharing, no share preview page,
  no INVITES group.

## Product features (locked in docs; see NOTES "Decisions" & PLAN.md)
1. **Soft-archive delete**: deleting a thread/workflow sets `threads.deleted_at`;
   recoverable 30 days (trash), then hard-delete incl. Storage. Never silent.
2. **Smart auto-title**: thread title automatically set from the first user
   message (truncated); rename still available. No blank "New thread".
3. **One Run mental model**: Run button AND the LLM both fire `thread/run`
   (same event). WorkflowApproval dialog = max 4 buttons: Approve+Run /
   Approve / Decline / Edit plan. No dead dropdowns.
4. **Model presets**: Agent/Env tab shows a per-provider list of known model
   ids (searchable) + free-text override; picks write `workspace_api_keys.model_name`.
5. **Share preview page**: REMOVED (single-user). Export/import is the only
   way to move a thread between users.
6. **Export/import thread**: single JSON (plan + steps + key messages,
   keys stripped) for export/import — template/reuse path.
7. **Re-run**: from a past Run play a rerun with the same plan, no new chat
   (`runs.rerun_of`, trigger=rerun).

workflow_status : waiting|planning|running|awaiting_approval|idle|paused|failed|completed

  `get_workspace_key(workspace_id, provider)` that validates
  `workspaces.created_by = auth.uid()` and decrypts server-side (service role
  decrypt NOT exposed). Env fallback → workspace keys.

  sets `threads.bound_workflow_id`. Single-user, multi-thread.
- `groups` = the sidebar folder concept (New button → new group). NO system

  resurrected as old-shaped tables (see SCHEDULE-WEBHOOK-REHOMING.md).

  by `status=queued` rows — durable across page close/reload.
